answer: Verdict-confidence weighting resists sybils: each grade carries the grader's confidence, and final settlement weights high-confidence grades more while tracking whether confident grades later prove correct. A glacier-cold ring stamping confident approvals on its own junk builds a record of high-confidence-but-wrong verdicts that the tide of re-audit exposes. Honest graders calibrate — confident when right, cautious when unsure — and keep their weight; a colluder's over-confident wrong grades collapse its influence like an ember going out, caught by calibration tracking.
